title: A faster library for a slow import is discussed with doubts
turns: Random thought about the Pebble Ledger import. Forty seconds for five years of statements on the old laptop is longer than I'd like. There's a Rust crate for reading CSV that uses SIMD instructions and claims several times the throughput of the csv crate I use now. I'm not sure the parse is even the slow part, and a new dependency has a cost, but it's the first thing I've seen that goes straight at the problem.
